author: Latin Business Daily
title: Government streamlines tax benefits access for seniors and people with disabilities
text:
Government streamlines tax benefits access for seniors and people with disabilities
The government announced on Aug. 12 that senior citizens and people with disabilities can now more easily access special reductions on the Motor Vehicle Property Tax through automated and online services provided by the Internal Revenue Service (SRI).
When a senior citizen or person with a disability purchases a new vehicle from a dealership, the tax reduction is applied automatically, provided they do not have another vehicle registered in their name.
Current regulations state that this benefit may be applied to only one vehicle per individual. If the taxpayer owns two or more vehicles, they can select which one will receive the reduction using SRI en Línea on the website www.sri.gob.ec by logging in with their username and password.
To complete the process, users must log into SRI en Línea, select Vehicles, go to Exonere sus vehículos, choose their car, and confirm the request. If a reduction has already been applied to another vehicle during the same fiscal period, the system will ask for authorization to transfer the benefit to the selected car.
Once registered, this benefit renews automatically at the start of each new fiscal year as long as eligibility requirements are maintained under current regulations.
The government said these digital tools strengthen process simplification and make it easier for citizens to access tax benefits through faster and more efficient services.
